_doc: GitHub Copilot coding-agent hook. Schema: https://docs.github.com/en/copilot/reference/hooks-configuration . The Copilot cloud coding agent runs on Linux and honors bash only, so this file wires bash commands (no powershell entry by design). preToolUse denies a tool call by emitting a permissionDecision; copilot_hook_adapter.py parses the documented toolName/toolArgs (and VS Code tool_name/tool_input) shapes. Commands resolve repo root via git for subdirectory launches.
